newsitem.title: USA: Early fire extinguished at Paramount Calif. plant.
newsitem.headline: Early fire extinguished at Paramount Calif. plant.

text.p: Firefighters extinguished an early morning blaze at Paramount Petroleum Corp's 42,200 barrel-per-day (bpd) refinery south of Los Angeles, a spokesman for the Los Angeles County Fire department said.
The fire occurred in a large heating unit containing naptha and hydrogen, causing minor injuries to two workers.
The official said firefighters contained the blaze soon after it was reported at midnight.
"It was under control at 0024 (PST), under 15 minutes," said Henry Henry Rodriguez, a fire official.
He did not know the cause of the fire or impact on operations, but added refineries typically run duplicate heating units, allowing the plant to run normally.
"It may affect that certain area but it may not affect the rest of the plant," Rodriguez said.
Paramount officials were not immediately available for comment.
